predictions.rationale: Explicit action class whose sole purpose is to create/open a Deployment Diagram; direct entry point for the feature in the UI.
Initialization class that registers the Deployment Diagram type, its renderer, graph model, etc.; central to enabling the feature.
Main diagram class representing Deployment Diagrams; handles diagram-level behavior and appearance.
Graph model that stores nodes/artifacts and their relationships for Deployment Diagrams; core data structure.
Responsible for rendering Deployment Diagram elements (nodes, artifacts, links) on screen; essential for visualizing the feature.
Provides the property panel for Deployment Diagrams, allowing users to view/edit diagram-specific properties.
Factory that creates the property panel for Deployment Diagrams; directly tied to the UI support of the feature.
Alternative/extended implementation of the Deployment Diagram in the newer ‘deployment2’ module.
Factory responsible for creating Deployment2 diagrams; crucial for instantiating the feature in the modular architecture.
Graph model for the newer Deployment2 diagrams, managing nodes and artifacts relationships.
